# Standcast

> Standcast orchestrates a team's daily standup. Each person drafts their daily from GitHub and Linear activity inside their AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, any MCP client) or the terminal, confirms it, and Standcast posts one digest per team to Slack. Open source (MIT), free during the public beta.

## Landing

- [Home](https://standcast.usefachada.dev/index.md): what Standcast does, a day with it, privacy in short, the install command and the beta
- [How it works](https://standcast.usefachada.dev/how-it-works/index.md): the daily timeline, what it does, standcast.yml and the three ways to write
- [Privacy](https://standcast.usefachada.dev/privacy/index.md): who sees what, what Standcast reads and where the full privacy details live
- [Pricing](https://standcast.usefachada.dev/pricing/index.md): free during the public beta, pricing announced before the beta ends
- [FAQ](https://standcast.usefachada.dev/faq/index.md): answers before you install
- [Join the beta](https://standcast.usefachada.dev/beta/index.md): request access to the public beta
